en: The content of this site derives from the doctoral thesis in Law presented by Dr. Victor L. P. Andrade to the Graduate Program in Law of São Paulo State University (UNESP), School of Humanities and Social Sciences, under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Luciana Lopes Canavez.

The research began on a path that crossed the institutional dimension of industrial property and came into focus in interactive entertainment, where enjoyment depends on private centres of decision and on opaque infrastructures. It did not begin from a prior institutional agenda, but from a discomfort that recurred for years, while technical layers stopped being tools and began to work as an environment.
The research was supported by the Coordination for the Improvement of Higher Education Personnel (CAPES), Finance Code 001, under grant no. 88887.670298/2022-00.

This site was built with supervised use of artificial intelligence, from the conceptual illustrations to the organisation of the text, the English translation and the code that assembles the pages. The content starts from the thesis, and whatever came after it is marked as an addition. The site is under constant review and improvement, and each version corrects and expands the previous one.
